Find sources: "Tennis at the 2018 Mediterranean Games – Women's doubles" – news · newspapers · books · scholar · JSTOR ( June 2018 ) ( Learn how and when to remove this message ) Women's doubles Tennis at the 2018 Mediterranean Games Events Singles men women Doubles men women ← 2013 · Mediterranean Games · 2022 → 2018 tennis event results Main article: Tennis at the 2018 Mediterranean  Games The women's doubles event at the 2018 Mediterranean Games was held from 26 to 29 June at the Tarragona Tennis Club. [ 1 ] Başak Eraydın and İpek Öz of Turkey won the gold medal, defeating Nefisa Berberović and Dea Herdželaš of Bosnia and Herzegovina in the final, 0–6, 6–3, [12–10]. Marina Bassols Ribera and Eva Guerrero Álvarez of Spain won the bronze medal, defeating Fiona Ferro and Harmony Tan of France in the bronze medal match, 7–5, 7–5.
